title: Deputy Director General (Tech Centre)
sessionTitle: Use of Aadhar by Private Entities - SWIK Rules & Aadhaar App
bio:
Tanusree Deb Barma was born on 7 October 1982 in Tripura. She made history as the first woman from Tripura to pass the UPSC Civil Services Examination in 2006 and join the IAS directly. Bright and ambitious, she earned her B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering from IIT Delhi, later complementing her technical background with a Master’s in Public Policy (M.P.P.) from IGNOU, New Delhi.
She currently head the Technology Centre and Data Centre for Aadhaar and is responsible for management of the technology solutions for Aadhaar. The UIDAI team is present in GFF this year with an attractive stall on face authentication and a invite only closed door meeting for engaging with the Fintech community to enable usage of Aadhaar more innovative, seamless and secure manner.
She has also served in various capacities in state govt of Tripura and Karnataka notably in the depts. Like Secretary Finance, Science, Technology & Environment, Information Technology, Tribal Welfare Departments and Joint Managing Director, KUIDFC.
During her tenure as Secretary Finance, Tripura, the state implemented various key initiatives in DBT with special emphasis on Targeting Tribal and Women population. She implemented of Direct Benefit Transfers through ABPS to Targeted beneficiaries during COVID period. Under her leadership the team implemented several reforms in revenue and welfare administration enabled by IT. Her team launched and implemented the Guaranteed Delivery of Citizen services Act in Tripura, used GIS applications for Demarcation of Forest Land for Tribal Forest Dwellers etc. She implemented several Tribal Welfare schemes for Girl Children including and Tribal Women Self Help Groups. She ran an innovative PPP project called “any one can code”, which was a 1 year certified training program in computer programming with guaranteed job opportunity, for 10th pass tribal girl students.
As Director, IT and BT, GoK, she spearheaded drafting and launching the Startup Policy for Karnataka and was instrumental in executing many pioneering projects like the Government of Karnataka-NASSCOM Startup Warehouse and similar incubators. she played a key role in launching Asia’s largest technology incubation facility in Bangalore—a visionary initiative blending hackathon-style innovation and startup acceleration. She also was pivotal in launching the KITVEN-3 fund for Biotech and life sciences startups and set up the incubator-Bangalore Bio Innovation Centre in Electronics City, Bangalore. Karnataka is presently counted among the top few States in the Country for the execution of the Government of India’s Startup India Initiative
Tanusree Deb Barma’s journey reflects a dynamic blend of technical expertise and administrative leadership. Her grounding in engineering and public policy allowed her to contribute effectively across domains—from grassroots governance in Tripura to urban infrastructure schemes in Karnataka, and now to national digital identity systems at UIDAI.
At every turn, she has demonstrated a capacity to innovate, lead modernization efforts, and serve varied portfolios with commitment and competence.

name: Smt. Nirmala Sitharaman
title: Hon'ble Minister of Finance & Corporate Affairs
sessionTitle: Empowering Finance for a Better World - Powered by AI
bio:
Smt Nirmala Sitharaman was born on 18th August, 1959 in Madurai, Tamil Nadu to Smt K. Savitri and Shri K. Sitharaman. She completed her bachelors from Seethalakshmi Ramaswami College in Tiruchirapalli and headed to the Jawahar Lal Nehru University to pursue her masters in Economics. 
From 2003-2005, she served as a member of the National Commission for Women and in 2008, she was invited to become a member of the BJP’s National Executive and since then she has been actively involved in drafting almost all of party’s Economic and Political Resolutions. In 2010, Smt. Sitharaman was appointed as the National Spokesperson of the BJP and was widely respected for her well researched and graceful articulation of the party’s stand. 
During the Gujarat Assembly Elections in 2012, Smt. Sitharaman worked directly under the leadership of Shri Narendra Modi wherein she was given the responsibility of organizing BJP’s Media Campaign for the elections. After the historic victory of BJP in 2014 General Elections, she was inducted into the Council of Ministers and she held the charge of Minister of State (Independent charge) for Commerce & Industry. 
In May 2016, she was one of the 12 candidates nominated by the BJP to contest the Rajya Sabha elections on 11 June 2016. She successfully contested her seat from Karnataka. On 3 September 2017, she became the first full- time woman Defence Minister of India. After landslide victory of BJP in the General Elections of 2019, Smt Sitharaman was given the responsibility of the Finance and Corporate Affairs Minister of India. 
During the COVID-19 pandemic, she was made in-charge of the COVID-19 Economic Response Task Force and it was also during her tenure as Finance Minister that India became the fifth largest economy in the world.
In 2022, she was re-elected as Member of Parliament in Rajya Sabha from Karnataka.
Smt Sitharaman again became the Finance and Corporate Affairs Minister after the formation of the NDA government under the leadership of Hon’ble Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi following victory in the 2024 General Assembly Elections.
